description: An eight-shaft 4/4 straight twill sampler, 16 ends by 16 picks, rising shed, treadled 1 to 8 and back up, with the slips a weaver makes: pick 5 presses treadle 9, which the 8-treadle tie-up does not have; pick 2 is marked tabby, but its shed is a twill shed, not plain weave (every other pick is a pattern pick); picks 15 and 16 are one shed (treadle 7 twice), grouped as a double shot. Checked against the four-shaft jack loom of fixtures/weaving/looms/looms.json (4 shafts, 6 treadles, 24 in wide, 12- and 10-dent reeds) with no sett entered and none in the file. Readiness: the treadle error blocks (the drawdown and the printed directions would be wrong); the tabby role and the two loom conflicts (8 shafts on 4, 9 treadles on 6) only warn, since the draft may be right for another loom; the width and the reed are not checked without a sett; the double shot's selvedge advice is information. Fits (the treadles pressed one at a time, the rising shed on a jack loom) are not listed.

items.message: Pick 5 presses treadle 9 which has no tie-up
Pick 2 marked tabby but its shed does not weave plain weave
Does not fit Four-shaft jack loom, the loom chosen for this draft: This draft threads 8 shafts; Four-shaft jack loom has 4.
Does not fit Four-shaft jack loom, the loom chosen for this draft: This draft uses 9 treadles; Four-shaft jack loom has 6.
The sett is not known, so the width was not checked: the file gives no warp spacing.
The sett is not known, so no reed was chosen.
Picks 15 and 16 are a double shot: a shuttle that passes again in the same shed needs the weft caught at the selvedge, for example with a floating selvedge
